title: Top bar jumps 7.5 px horizontally when navigating / -> /genes (confirmed known bug)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-gene/nav.mjs with real (non-overlay) scrollbars: at 1440x900 header container x=72.5 on /, x=80.0 at t=300 ms (page empties during out-in fade, scrollbar disappears, sbw 15->0), back to 72.5 at 450 ms. At 1920x1080 /genes is shorter than the viewport (scrollHeight 1080) so the header stays at x=192 vs 184.5 on / and /genes/PKD1 — a permanent 7.5 px shift. Headless overlay-scrollbar run (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-gene/results.json nav) shows no shift, confirming the scrollbar as cause.
impact: Every route change with a length difference visibly shakes the logo and nav; looks broken and is the first thing users notice.
fix: Add `scrollbar-gutter: stable` to the existing `html {}` rule in main.css (line 148). Optional: keep main min-height during the fade (App.vue:69 `mode="out-in"` empties <main> for ~200 ms).

title: out-in route transition empties <main>, collapsing the document to viewport height for ~200 ms on every navigation
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-gene/nav.mjs: scrollHeight 2425 -> 900 -> 993 between t=200 and 450 ms after clicking Gene Browser; footer flashes up to the header.
impact: Causes the scrollbar flip above, a blank flash and scroll-position jumps on each route change.
fix: Use a cross-fade without out-in (or no transition) for page routes, or give <main> a min-height while transitioning.

title: All <button>s (Login, theme toggle, Share, Export, Copy symbol, Sources/Tiers filters, pagination, sort headers, accordion/Evidence Detail triggers, HoverPopover chips, structure tabs) show cursor: default (confirmed known bug)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-gene/results.json cursor.*.nonPointer: / 7 of 36 interactive elements, /genes 28/59, /genes/PKD1 (expanded) 49/79, structure 15/52 are buttons with computed cursor `default`; links are `pointer`. Includes "Share", "Export", "Copy gene symbol", each Evidence Details card trigger (e.g. "GenCC 6 submissions…", 1246x56), "Show 3 More Submissions", "View All Term IDs", all 26 Gene Information chips.
impact: Interactive controls look inert next to links; whole Evidence cards look non-expandable. Root cause: Tailwind v4 preflight resets button cursor to default and neither the Button cva (button/index.ts:7), AccordionTrigger (accordion/AccordionTrigger.vue:22) nor HoverPopover (ui/HoverPopover.vue:43) add cursor-pointer.
fix: One base rule in assets/main.css @layer base: `button:not(:disabled), [role=button], [role=tab], summary, label[for] { cursor: pointer }`; then delete ad-hoc `cursor-pointer` classes (e.g. GeneStructureVisualization.vue:23, ScoreBreakdown.vue:100).
